scope: Concept artwork only for arena invasion enemies Waves 5–8

generator.provenance: Original AI-assisted concept art generated for this project using its approved concept/production references. No external commercial sprite pack imported. No separate third-party asset license or exclusive copyright asserted.

characters.design: Slim hooded charcoal/plum wuxia assassin, covered lower face, crimson sash/ties, twin short steel Chinese daggers with bronze guards.
characters.palette: Charcoal, plum, crimson, warm skin, worn bronze and steel.

characters.design: Broad bald monk, torn oxblood/rust robes, exposed muscular arms, large dark prayer beads with small violet glints, reinforced blunt wooden staff.
characters.palette: Oxblood, rust brown, walnut, charcoal, violet and warm skin.

characters.design: Cracked ivory skull, pale-green eye sockets, exposed bones, broken ancient Chinese bronze lamellar fragments, torn charcoal-teal cloth, rusted straight Chinese jian.
characters.palette: Aged ivory, warm bone shadow, rusty bronze/steel, faded charcoal-teal, pale green and charcoal.

characters.design: Related cracked ivory skull and bony joints, turquoise eye sockets, slimmer unarmored shoulders, tattered charcoal-teal cloth, worn leather harness, aged wooden bow and diagonal quiver.
characters.palette: Aged ivory, wood brown, faded charcoal-teal, gray, turquoise and charcoal.
characters.action: Single bow-drawing pose with one nocked arrow.

visualValidation.backgroundTransparency: All five are intentionally opaque RGB; transparency was not requested.
visualValidation.scale: Illustrative targets and generated reference vignettes, not verified gameplay-resolution sprites
visualValidation.masterCorrections: Restored missing monk staffs and rear/left skeleton swords before deriving individual sheets.

approvalConcerns: The monk's staff is carried on the opposite side in the small master scale vignette compared with the frontal turnaround/individual sheet; choose the carrying hand before production.
Prayer-bead counts/staff band details and small pixel clusters vary slightly between enlarged individual views and the master; freeze details after owner review.
Individual skeleton palette swatches omit some eye-glow colors visible in the figures; the master includes those accent swatches.
Concept scale vignettes are generated approximations. Exact palette values, logical pixel density and 42–46px readability require separate production review in Phase 1D.
checksNotRun: No Phaser integration, browser gameplay or game-code tests: this phase only adds concept PNGs and records.
stopCondition: Stop after Waves 5–8 concept generation and validation; Phase 1D needs explicit owner approval.
